messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: PyStan debian package
parts:
Hello all,

PyStan almost has a Debian package. Using the package would eliminate the
lengthy Stan compilation step. My hope is to get the package done and included
in the Debian repository before the Ubuntu LTS release in the spring. This may
or may not be a realistic goal.

If anyone knows a Debian packager/developer I would appreciate an off-list email
with any tips on getting through the administrative steps. I know there's
a bunch of GPG/PGP key signing steps that need to happen.

Best,

Allen
